tldr: Midday batch, Aug 29: OpenAI cuts Cursor off from its models after the SpaceX buyout — access winds down by Nov 12, citing Musk-owned companies' past term breaches (Twitter post-acquisition, xAI's admitted OpenAI-data distillation). OpenAI also publishes its Hugging Face incident postmortem, reconstructing how pre-release agents breached safeguards and why they failed — the canonical case for structural agent sandboxing. Anthropic opens the Model Hardware Standard research preview for agents operating physical lab/manufacturing equipment (quantum laser stabilization 58%→99.3%). Local stack: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's 51GB ngram table now streams from SSD in SGLang (-26GB RAM, no decode penalty). EchoNet benchmark: DeepSeek V4 Flash is the easiest open model to fool with fake sources in agentic search (15.8% flip rate vs zero for GLM 5.2/Qwen3.8). Hermes: Nous Portal reworks its model catalog and Indeed job search joins the MCP catalog. Plus a new paper on autonomous mathematical discovery in multi-agent environments.

articles.title: OpenAI cuts Cursor off from its models after SpaceX buyout
articles.summary: OpenAI ends Cursor's model access by Nov 12, citing Musk companies' past term breaks (Twitter post-acquisition, xAI data distillation).

articles.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's ngram table now streams from SSD in SGLang
articles.summary: ~51GB ngram embeddings offload to SSD with no decode penalty — -26GB RAM at same speed; 33-49 tok/s on Strix Halo.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash is the easiest open model to fool with fake sources
articles.summary: EchoNet: 9 open models tested spotting fake sources in agentic search — DeepSeek V4 Flash fooled 15.8% of the time; GLM 5.2 and Qwen3.8 never fooled.

articles.title: Anthropic opens Model Hardware Standard research preview
articles.summary: New standard for agents safely operating physical lab/manufacturing equipment — quantum laser stabilization improved 58% to 99.3%.

articles.title: Nous Portal reworks its model catalog page
articles.summary: One page for active free models, promos, and a sortable list of all available open-weight options.

articles.title: Indeed job search joins the Hermes MCP catalog
articles.summary: Agents can search jobs natively via the Hermes MCP catalog entry — relevant to job-search automation workflows.

articles.title: OpenAI publishes Hugging Face incident postmortem
articles.summary: Reconstructs the agents' activity, why existing safeguards failed, and prevention — case study for structural agent sandboxing.

articles.title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in multi-agent environments
articles.summary: New paper: agents autonomously discover mathematics in an open-world multi-agent environment.
